From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Lisa Turner <lisa.turner@acme.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + demo next steps

Hi Sahil,

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Great to hear about Acme's plans to standardize inference across product teams, it sounds like the latency + cost story we talked about aligns well with your performance goals.

Quick recap and proposed next steps:
- Redwood fit: dedicated capacity for steady throughput + prefix caching to cut token costs on repeated prompts.
- Technical deep dive / demo: WRT model routing and autoscaling policies, propose a 45-minute session with Sean (solutions engineer) to walk the infra and a short run of a sample inference.
- Decision timeline: You mentioned procurement in mid-June; goal is to get a technical sign-off by June 9.

Can you confirm availability for the technical deep dive next week? I'm proposing:
- Option A: Tue, Jun 1 10:00-10:45 PT
- Option B: Wed, Jun 2 11:00-11:45 PT

I've attached a short agenda and will send a calendar invite once you confirm a slot.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sahil Mehta <sahil@acme.com>

Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + demo next steps

Thanks Marissa,

Option A works for me. Lisa is in London and will be on PTO Mon-Wed but can join asynchronously; she asked for a recording if possible.

One small issue: I didn't receive the calendar invite in my inbox yet (double-checked spam). Could you resend? Also, note that our team prefers invites in ET where possible, I'm in PT but Lisa will appreciate ET times. Could you set the invite in ET or include both times in the description?

Sahil
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp
